name: Jia Wei Lifestyle, Inc.
summary: Jia Wei Lifestyle, Inc. focuses on the creation, manufacturing, and distribution of various items for the home. Their diverse product range includes dining essentials such as plates, bowls, and storage jars, alongside a selection of beverage containers like cups and drinking jars. Additionally, they market a line of kitchen implements under their 'prepara' brand. The company initially operated as Gamma Optical Co., LTD, before officially changing its name to Jia Wei Lifestyle, Inc. in August of 2019. Established in 2005, the firm maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
